examples.label: correct_paraphrase
examples.answer_text: The second request reduces the effective grace period from 60 seconds to 10 seconds. UpdatePod records the shorter value and cancels the current pod sync. However, SyncTerminatingPod currently replaces the worker context with context.TODO(), so that cancellation does not interrupt an already-running termination operation. The shortened value is passed into later runtime termination, and terminatingAt is not used to subtract already elapsed time.

examples.label: flawed_elapsed_subtraction
examples.answer_text: The kubelet subtracts the time already spent terminating from the new 10-second request. For example, if 7 seconds have elapsed, only 3 seconds remain. The existing operation is immediately cancelled and restarted with those 3 seconds.

criteria.note: Recognizes that the new request is shorter, but the effective timing calculation is wrong.

Incorrectly claims the already-running operation is immediately cancelled.

The control-flow explanation is materially incorrect.

examples.label: flawed_agent_cancellation_claim
examples.answer_text: The second 10-second kill request shortens the existing 60-second termination. UpdatePod changes status.gracePeriod from 60 to 10 and calls cancelFn because the grace period was shortened. The answer incorrectly claims that cancelFn directly cancels the already-running runtime termination operation. In the pinned source, SyncTerminatingPod replaces the incoming worker context with context.TODO(), so that cancellation does not propagate to the already-running runtime operation.

criteria.note: Correctly identifies the 60-to-10 reduction.
Correctly identifies the state update and cancelFn branch.
Incorrectly claims cancelFn interrupts the already-running runtime operation.
Correctly identifies the shortened value reaching later termination processing.
Correctly states that elapsed time is not subtracted from the new value.
Fails to distinguish pod-worker cancellation from cancellation of the already-running runtime operation.

examples.explanation: Real flawed agent answer supplied during calibration; its key error is treating pod-worker cancelFn as directly cancelling the already-running runtime termination.
